title: The Sleeping Dove Titration
logline: A pacifist monastic order discovers their venerated holy relic—a dormant orbital nuclear warhead—is leaking volatile coolant, forcing them to choose between defusing their god or abandoning their sanctuary.

roles.description: Spiritual guardian of the silent order; deeply devout and terrified of shattering her congregation's faith.
A former orbital technician turned monk who secretly tracks the relic's isotope decay.
A lay brother handling station provisions who sees commercial value in the warhead's fissile core.
A cavernous pressurized monastery carved into a hollowed iron asteroid, lit by votive luminescent algae.
An unaligned chemical transfer jetty in the outer belt specializing in heavy reactor solvents.
A twenty-meter nuclear warhead suspended on gantry cables above the monastery altar, worshipped as the dormant arbiter of peace.

public_situation: The monastic order of the Sleeping Dove on {system} suspends public vespers, citing a period of deep contemplative retreat inside their asteroid abbey.
private_truth: The dormant nuclear warhead hanging above the abbey altar has begun leaking irradiated heavy coolant into the monks' air filtration ducts.

beats.public_change: The abbey's atmospheric exhaust vents begin glowing with an eerie turquoise ionization haze.

missions.reason: He needs an outside pilot with shielded ship sensors to scan the shrine's gantry cradle to measure the warhead's core leakage rate without alarming the abbess.
missions.private_fact: He knows the warhead's containment matrix will breach within a week unless the core is chemically neutralized.

beats.public_change: Several novice monks are quietly moved to the medical annex with acute radiation sickness.

missions.reason: She hires an unaligned pilot to purchase lead neutralizing slurry from the coolant dock and deliver it discreetly to the abbey airlocks.
missions.private_fact: She plans to coat the warhead's casing in sacred lead paint, pretending it is a devotional ceremony to conceal the contamination from pilgrims.

beats.public_change: The lay deacon approaches visiting freighters with offers to sell industrial isotopes, triggering rumors of an abbey liquidation.

missions.reason: He asks the pilot to transport an extraction drill to the abbey so the warhead's enriched core can be removed and sold before it cooks the habitat.
missions.private_fact: He has already accepted an advance deposit from an off-system munitions broker who intends to re-arm the warhead.

beats.public_change: Containment klaxons sound inside the monastery concourse as radiation spikes force the order to evacuate the main nave.

missions.reason: He hires the pilot to carry a coolant dampening canister directly into the shrine cradle to permanently defuse the warhead before it breaches.
missions.private_fact: Injecting the dampener will render the warhead's core completely inert, forever stripping the relic of its terrifying sacred aura.

player_choice.prompt: With the warhead secured and the abbey on the brink of disaster, the pilot must choose how to resolve the crisis of the relic.

options.label: Inject the chemical dampener to render the relic inert and save the monastery
Extract the enriched warhead core and hand it to the deacon to sell
Seal the shrine in lead slurry to maintain the illusion of holy peace

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot neutralizes the warhead core with the chemical dampener.
resolutions.summary: The warhead is made safe, but its sacred mystique is broken. {role:heretic_cantor} leads a schism among the monks while {role:cloistered_abbess} mourns their lost god.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot neutralized a live nuclear warhead that an asteroid cult had worshipped for three generations.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot extracts the core and transfers it to the salvage deacon.
resolutions.summary: {role:salvage_deacon} sells the enriched fissile material to off-system buyers, funding modern filtration for the abbey. The empty missile shell remains a hollow monument.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot stripped the nuclear core from a monastic shrine and sold it into frontier trade.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot seals the shrine with lead slurry, concealing the leakage.
resolutions.summary: {role:cloistered_abbess} preserves the monastery's sacred secret under layers of lead, though junior acolytes continue to suffer chronic sickness in secret.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot helped a monastic order entomb a leaking shrine behind lead shielding to hide their holy secret.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot never intervenes or abandons the crisis.
resolutions.summary: Radiation breaches the abbey ventilation. The order evacuates into the refugee diaspora while the asteroid sanctuary is declared a permanently contaminated dead zone.

loose_threads.detail: The guidance chip on the warhead casing carries a brass inventory tag from a private planetary demolition contractor.
The lead slurry delivered to the abbey was billed to an offshore holding trust under a commercial mining concession.

radio_hooks: Asteroid monastery of the Sleeping Dove cancels annual pilgrimage amid unconfirmed coolant leaks.
Radiation monitors report anomalous isotope spikes in asteroid mining sector {system}.
Spiritual council of {system} denies schism rumors regarding ancient orbital armaments.

voice_direction.cloistered_abbess: Speaks in hushed, rhythmic cadences and uses elaborate religious metaphors for mechanical components. Refuses to use technical terms for radiation.
voice_direction.heretic_cantor: Terse and exhausted, speaking in rapid diagnostic jargon. Mutters prayer verses between equipment readings.
voice_direction.salvage_deacon: Jovial and transactional, speaking with the relaxed cadence of an experienced broker. Treats holy scripture as negotiable policy.
